name: @kamiazya/whiteboard-reference-graph
description: What the documents of a workspace point at, as a graph: the facts one document contributes (its references, its searchable texts, its tag bearers), the aggregate that answers backlinks and unlinked mentions from them, and the frontier-stamped cache that keeps those facts between reads. Pure and runtime-agnostic, so both keepers answer the same questions the same way.
